SELECT b.book_id, b.isbn, b.book_name, b.author_id, a.author_name, b.type_id, t.type_name, b.publisher, b.publish_date, b.book_status, CASE b.book_status WHEN 0 THEN 'available' WHEN 1 THEN 'borrowed' WHEN 2 THEN 'disabled' END AS book_status_text FROM book b JOIN author a ON b.author_id = a.author_id JOIN book_type t ON b.type_id = t.type_id
AND ( b.book_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.isbn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.author_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND b.book_status = #{status}
ORDER BY b.book_id DESC

SELECT b.book_id, b.isbn, b.book_name, b.author_id, a.author_name, b.type_id, t.type_name, b.publisher, b.publish_date, b.book_status, CASE b.book_status WHEN 0 THEN 'available' WHEN 1 THEN 'borrowed' WHEN 2 THEN 'disabled' END AS book_status_text FROM book b JOIN author a ON b.author_id = a.author_id JOIN book_type t ON b.type_id = t.type_id WHERE b.book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book ( isbn, book_name, author_id, type_id, publisher, publish_date, book_status ) VALUES ( #{isbn}, #{bookName}, #{authorId}, #{typeId}, #{publisher}, #{publishDate}, #{bookStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET isbn = #{isbn}, book_name = #{bookName}, author_id = #{authorId}, type_id = #{typeId}, publisher = #{publisher}, publish_date = #{publishDate}, book_status = #{bookStatus} WHERE book_id = #{bookId}
